title: Amazon S3 to Amazon EventBridge to AWS Lambda
description: Creates an S3 bucket that publishes events to EventBridge that are routed to Lambda.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern contains a sample AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) template for creating an AWS S3 bucket with AWS EventBridge notifications turned on
All S3 events in this bucket is sent to AWS EventBridge
This CDK template also deploys a AWS Lambda function which will process the event sent to AWS EventBridge and create a tag for the S3 object that was created
An EventBridge rule is also created to send only the Object Created event of the bucket to the Lambda function
